name: The New Year
overview: The New Year invites believers to place full trust in the Lord rather than their own understanding, recognizing that while humans plan their way, it is God who directs their steps. Scripture encourages us to leave behind past failures and look forward with hope, assured that God’s mercies and compassions never fail. He promises to renew our hearts and spirits, granting us a fresh start grounded in His peace and purpose for our lives.
